# Source Code

#### Course: Learn Recursion With Java

## Source Code

```java
1class Main {
2    
3    public static int calculateSum(int n) {
4
5        if (n == 1) {
6            return 1;
7        }
8
9        return n + calculateSum(n - 1);
10    }
11
12    public static void main(String[] args) {
13
14        int result = calculateSum(3);
15        System.out.println(result);
16    }
17}
18
19// Output: 6
```

By the way, here's the equivalent code using an object instead of a static method.

```java
1class Main {
2    
3    public int calculateSum(int n) {
4
5        if (n == 1) {
6            return 1;
7        }
8
9        return n + calculateSum(n - 1);
10    }
11
12    public static void main(String[] args) {
13
14        Main obj = new Main();
15        int result = obj.calculateSum(3);
16        System.out.println(result);
17    }
18}
19
20// Output: 6
```
